name: prec-missing-field-before-pointer
comment: §8.3.5(1 before 2): add missing value AND a malformed index -> INVALID_OPERATION, not INVALID_POINTER

name: prec-pointer-before-existence
comment: §8.3.5(2 before 3): a malformed array index outranks the target being out of range -> INVALID_POINTER

name: prec-unsafe-key-before-existence
comment: §8.3.5(2 before 3): the UNSAFE_KEY guard is a pointer-stage check, ahead of existence

name: prec-existence-before-value
comment: §8.3.5(3 before 4): a nonexistent target outranks OLD_VALUE_MISMATCH -> PATH_UNRESOLVABLE

name: prec-index-bounds-before-value
comment: §8.3.5(2/3 before 4): an out-of-range index outranks the value check

name: prec-later-op-index-reported
comment: §8.6.2: operationIndex is the 0-based index of the FAILING op
